terra.problem: The verse says Sheol is naked before God and Abaddon has no covering. It does not say that nothing within them is covered or describe their deepest spot.
The claim that nothing is too deep or too covered up goes beyond what Job says about Sheol and Abaddon.
The joke introduces visits from the cookie cutter kids' friends, inventing a detail about his kids and suggesting visits not established in his story.
Rahab is named without distinguishing this figure from the better-known Rahab of Jericho.
